''[[M20|I Choose You!]]'' ({{pkmn|movie}}) |counterpart=[[Tierno (anime)]] |enva=[[Todd Haberkorn]] ([[Pokémon animated series|Animated series]]) |jpva=[[Anri Katsu]] ([[Pokémon animated series|Animated series]]) }} {{Character Infobox/Manga |color={{orange color light}} |series=''[[Pokémon Adventures]]'' |counterpart=[[Tierno (Adventures)]] |debut=''[[PS549|An X-cuse to Come Out and Play]]'' }} |} '''Tierno''' (Japanese: '''ティエルノ''' ''Tierno'') is a [[friend]] and [[rival]] of the {{player}} in {{g|X and Y}}. ==In the core series games== [[File:Friends XY.png|thumb|left|250px|Tierno with the player's other friends in Aquacorde Town]] Tierno appears in [[Pokémon X and Y]] as a friend of the player, to whom he gives the [[first partner Pokémon]] sent through him by [[Professor Sycamore]]. He is a dancer and his goal is to create a dance team with Pokémon and wants to find Pokémon with amazing moves. As such, the Pokémon in his party know "[[dance moves]]", such as {{m|Swords Dance}} and {{m|Petal Dance}}. Tierno is first met in [[Aquacorde Town]], where he delivers the player and two of their friends a [[first partner Pokémon]] on behalf of Professor Sycamore. He is then met at the [[Pokémon Center]] in [[Santalune City]], where he gives the player a minor tutorial on what is in the Pokémon Center. Tierno is first battled on {{rt|5|Kalos}}, and then again on {{rt|7|Kalos}}, albeit this time with [[Trevor]]. Tierno is next met in [[Reflection Cave]], where he gives the player a TM containing {{m|Flash}}. After the completion of the story line, Tierno can be found in [[Coumarine City]], asking to see a Pokémon knowing a randomly selected dance move each day, giving the player a [[Heart Scale]] if his request is fulfilled. Tierno also appears as one of the player's partners in the [[Battle Maison]] when choosing Multi Battle. Tierno does not appear in person in {{g|Legends: Z-A}}, but an NPC mentions that he has traveled to [[Unova]] and is making waves as a dancer. It is also revealed in the [[Mega Dimension]] DLC that [[Lida]] is his younger half-sister from another mother, though they've never met. ===Pokémon=== ====Gives to new Trainers==== Tierno delivers None of Charmander's moves are known.}} ===GOTCHA!=== Tierno briefly appeared in [[GOTCHA!]]. ==In the manga== [[File:Tierno Adventures.png|thumb|130px|Tierno in Pokémon Adventures]] ===Pokémon Adventures=== {{main|Tierno (Adventures)}} In the [[Pokémon Adventures]] {{pkmn|manga}}, Tierno is an aspiring dancer and [[Roller Skates|roller skater]]. Additionally, he is childhood friends with {{adv|X}}, {{adv|Y}}, {{adv|Trevor}}, and {{adv|Shauna}}. {{-}} ==In the TCG== [[File:TiernoKalosStarterSet39.jpg|201px|thumb|Tierno]] {{main|Tierno (Kalos Starter Set 39)}} '''Tierno''' was introduced as a {{TCG|Supporter Card}} in the [[Pokémon Trading Card Game]] at the beginning of the English XY Series (the Japanese XY Era). First released in the Japanese {{TCG|XY Beginning Set}}, the Tierno card later debuted in the English {{TCG|Kalos Starter Set}}, with both prints featuring an illustration based on the [[Ken Sugimori]] artwork of the character. With the same effect as {{TCG ID|Emerging Powers|Cheren|91}} from the {{TCG|Emerging Powers}} expansion, Tierno allows the player to draw three cards from their deck. {{-}} ==Trivia== * Tierno and [[Lida]] are the first sibling characters in the {{pkmn|games}} to be confirmed as half-siblings rather then full siblings. ** They are also the only siblings in the games to have never met each other. ==Names== {| class="roundtable" style="background:#{{orange color}}; border:3px solid #{{orange color dark}}" |- ! style="background:#{{orange color light}}" | Language ! style="background:#{{orange color light}}" | Name ! style="background:#{{orange color light}}" | Origin |- | Japanese | ティエルノ ''Tierno'' | From ''tierno'' (Spanish for "tender")In the [[Pokémon X and Y]] website, Tierno is introduced as a "kind boy" who is "burly and nimble" ([https://www.pokemon.co.jp/ex/xy/character/02.html 優しくて力持ちの男の子]), where the word 優しく ''yasashiku'' can be alternately translated as "gentle" and "tender" with both meanings corresponding to the Spanish word.
